findings.claim: Across the observed score window [0.0,0.49], landmark_00_local_dx shows a non-monotone profile: it rises to a positive peak near t≈0.10-0.11, then falls to a negative trough near t≈0.19, and returns toward baseline by the end of the window. The whole-window mean is slightly negative (whole_window_z≈-0.18) and the polynomial fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.78, 6 sign changes, 9 strong sign conflicts), so the shape is a transient contrast rather than a stationary offset.

landmark_00_local_dy is dominated by an early negative excursion: values are strongly negative over roughly t≈0.01-0.13, then recover to near zero and stay mildly negative for the rest of the window. The whole-window mean is negative (whole_window_z≈-0.30) and the polynomial fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.67, 6 sign changes, 4 strong sign conflicts).

landmark_00_local_dz is near zero on average over the window (whole_window_z≈-0.02) but is non-monotone: it is positive in the early-middle portion and becomes negative in the later portion, with 10 sign changes and 7 strong sign conflicts; the polynomial fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.72).

landmark_00_soft_mass has a positive whole-window mean (whole_window_z≈0.64) and a smoother profile than the dx/dy/dz coordinates: it rises to a positive plateau around t≈0.14-0.30 and declines toward zero by the end of the window. The polynomial fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.29, 4 sign changes, 1 strong sign conflict).

landmark_01_local_dx is positive early (t≈0.0-0.10), then negative through the middle of the window (t≈0.13-0.25), and returns toward zero by the end; whole-window mean is slightly negative (whole_window_z≈-0.22) with 4 sign changes and 10 strong sign conflicts, and the polynomial fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.71).

landmark_01_local_dy is negative for most of the window (whole_window_z≈-0.50), with the most negative values in the early-to-middle portion and a partial recovery toward zero near the end; the polynomial fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.59, 4 sign changes, 4 strong sign conflicts).

landmark_01_local_dz shows a pronounced early negative excursion (t≈0.0-0.10), a positive excursion in the middle (t≈0.13-0.20), and a return to near zero by the end; whole-window mean is near zero (whole_window_z≈-0.01) with 6 sign changes and 5 strong sign conflicts, and the polynomial fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.62).

landmark_01_soft_mass is positive early (t≈0.0-0.12), negative in the middle (t≈0.15-0.40), and recovers toward zero by the end; whole-window mean is slightly negative (whole_window_z≈-0.25) with 4 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts, and the polynomial fit was not accepted (relative_node_RMSE≈0.62).

hypotheses.falsifier: If the landmark_00_local_dx profile is flat or its sign pattern is not reproducible across independent batches, the proposed timing has no basis.
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score window [0.0,0.49]
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate exhibits a transient positive-then-negative contrast over the observed window, peaking near t≈0.10 and troughing near t≈0.19. A reward schedule that applies stronger curvature (larger delta) during the early-to-middle portion of the window and weaker curvature later would test whether this transient contrast is a useful control signal, while a constant-curvature control would test whether the timing matters.

hypotheses.falsifier: If the landmark_00_local_dy early negative excursion is not reproducible across independent batches, the proposed timing has no basis.

hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_local_dy coordinate is persistently negative over the early-to-middle portion of the window and recovers toward zero later. A reward schedule that applies stronger curvature during the early negative excursion and relaxes later would test whether this early contrast is a useful control signal.

hypotheses.direction: stronger curvature in the middle, weaker at the edges
hypotheses.falsifier: If the landmark_00_soft_mass plateau is not reproducible across independent batches, the proposed timing has no basis.

limitations: Only landmark_00 and landmark_01 features were read; the remaining 18 landmarks (landmark_02 through landmark_19) were not observed and are not covered by these findings.
No stage profiles or temporal profiles are available; all evidence is from continuous curves over the observed score window [0.0,0.49].
Polynomial fits were not accepted for any of the eight observed features, so the reported shapes are descriptive of the observed nodes and are not extrapolated beyond the window.
The observed curves are selection-associated contrasts, not measured guidance effects; no current outcome or decoded-affinity labels are available in this role input.
The dx/dy/dz and soft_mass features are untyped coordinate proxies; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached.
Several features show many sign changes and strong sign conflicts across independent batches, so the temporal ordering of contrasts is uncertain.
